'''Delrian''' was a prison world in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was the second planet in its system.

==History==
Prisoners worked the crust's mines; the ores extracted were exported to fund the prison.

[[Nuri]] the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] freed [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] from imprisonment on Delrian. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] later escaped from the planet after he was institutionalized there. Under the New Republic, the prison was overseen by [[Wardex]] [[Simyl Fruul]], who had to handle a prisoner revolt assisted by corrupt staffers at [[Mine Head 37]].
